Video With Music — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Effortlessly add AI-generated background music to your videos via a simple upload-and-describe workflow.
- Supports major video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB.
- Handles cloud rendering and returns music-backed videos in 30–90 seconds.
- Includes support for session management, balance checks, and exporting finished videos.
- Ideal for creators seeking fast music sync without complex editing tools.
